body:
SAFETY RULE, effective now (BUG-2624).
Do not run 'make check-ci-fast' (or pytest over tests/test_containment_conformance.py) from an interactive terminal.
On a foreground TTY, a mocked child pid makes scripts/containment/conformance.py:668 call killpg(1, SIGTERM), which is kill(-1): it kills every process the operator owns and logs out the desktop session (happened twice on 2026-11-15).
Run it only headless (no TTY) until the BUG-2624 fix is on main.
subject: SAFETY: no interactive check-ci-fast until BUG-2624 lands
